I’m not able to check real‑time inventory directly, but you can quickly see if the shirt is still in stock for sizes L and 4L by:

1. Visiting the product page on our website – the size selector will show “In Stock” or “Out of Stock.”  
2. Using the store’s mobile app (if you have it installed).  
3. Calling our customer service line at 1‑800‑XYZ‑1234; a representative can confirm availability and even reserve the item for you.

If you’d like, I can also help you place an order right now—just let me know your preferred size and shipping details!
